observations.observation: Micron’s September 30 release reported GAAP diluted EPS of $32.87 for the fiscal quarter ended September 3, 2026, and separately reported non-GAAP diluted EPS of $33.42.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This establishes the reported quarter’s result; it does not by itself establish persistence of results or later-period performance.

observations.observation: The supplied Dow Jones headline reports Q4 EPS of $32.87 at 16:01 ET, the same minute as the issuer’s full release. Its body is marked “MORE TO FOLLOW,” and the available metadata cannot establish which item appeared first within that minute.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The captured newswire item is headline-only; its generic provider URL does not independently expose the complete Dow Jones story.

observations.observation: Compared on like accounting bases, reported GAAP diluted EPS of $32.87 was $1.14 above the upper end of Micron’s prior GAAP outlook ($31.73); non-GAAP diluted EPS of $33.42 was $1.42 above the upper end of its prior non-GAAP outlook ($32.00).
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This comparison uses Micron’s own June guidance, not a verified matched-basis analyst consensus; GAAP and non-GAAP EPS are distinct measures.

observations.observation: Micron attributed the record results to AI-driven demand and operational execution and said it expected a stronger FY27; these are management’s characterization and forward-looking statement.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The outlook is forward-looking and does not independently verify future demand, supply, or earnings.

observations.observation: A retrieved Reuters syndication page surfaced a September 29 datelined forecast about HBM’s prospective share of industry DRAM wafer capacity, but its pre-cutoff snapshot and revision state could not be verified.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: Do not treat this lead as verified public-by-cutoff evidence or as proof of realized capacity or Micron-specific share.

gaps: Within the bounded search, no separate independent full report on Micron’s EPS with a verified publication time at or before cutoff was established; the supplied Dow Jones item is headline-only.
No matched-basis analyst consensus source with a verified pre-cutoff snapshot was established. The EPS comparison therefore uses Micron’s prior GAAP and non-GAAP guidance.
The concurrent Reuters/Samsung capacity forecast lacks a verified pre-cutoff snapshot and revision history, so it is retained only as an unverified lead.
The supplied event library mentions an Intel server-demand/supply update, but this bounded search did not independently verify a cutoff-eligible source for that item.
